summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market repurchases under its share buyback program launched December 15, 2025, covering transactions from August 31 to September 25, 2026. Weekly press releases detail daily purchases on US trading venues, including 50,000 shares at a weighted average of EUR 50.02 in the August 31-September 4 window. Cumulatively through September 4, 2026, Ferrovial repurchased 6,130,574 shares for EUR 355,279,920.85. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch execution pace, average price versus intrinsic value, and any buyback expansion.
